is a rare and special thing to come across a doctor who not only embodies the highest standards of clinical excellence, but who also radiates compassion, integrity, and genuine care for her patients. Dr. McKenzie at Greyswood Surgery epitomises everything the medical profession should stand for.

From the very first appointment, she put me at ease with her calm, thoughtful manner and unhurried approach. She listens — really listens — with both intelligence and empathy, making you feel seen, heard, and valued. Her ability to explain complex issues clearly, patiently, and without a trace of condescension is a gift that cannot be taught; it comes from a place of deep respect for her patients.

One area where Dr. McKenzie has had a particularly profound impact on my life is in helping me manage my diabetes. She took the time to understand not just the clinical side of my condition, but also how it affects my daily life, my mindset, and my routine. Her support has been both practical and empowering — from fine-tuning my treatment plan to offering encouragement and realistic lifestyle advice. Thanks to her guidance, I feel more in control of my health than ever before.

What sets Dr. McKenzie apart is her unwavering commitment to holistic care. She doesn’t just treat symptoms — she looks at the whole person. Her attention to detail, follow-up, and willingness to go the extra mile is something I’ve rarely encountered in any field, let alone in a busy NHS setting.

In every interaction, Dr. McKenzie demonstrates what it means to serve with dignity and purpose. She is not only a highly skilled clinician but also a source of strength, reassurance, and humanity. I leave every appointment feeling lighter, better informed, and profoundly grateful.
